mechanism_narrative: A sustained low level of federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may lead to increased borrowing and investment, thus driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the periods following low FEDFUNDS levels, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates a weakening labor market, which could lead to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the periods following a rise in UNRATE above 5.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises simultaneously with a slowdown in payroll employment growth, it signals a labor market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the periods following concurrent rises in UNRATE and slowdown in PAYEMS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) may lead to inflation concerns, prompting tighter monetary policy and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the periods following a rise in CPIAUCSL during a late-cycle expansion, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the periods following an increase in HOUST, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) may indicate supply constraints, leading to decreased production and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the periods following high INDPRO levels, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth (GDPC1) slows down while consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) rise, it indicates stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the periods following concurrent slowdown in GDPC1 and rise in CPIAUCSL, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the periods following strong PAYEMS growth, the hypothesis is rejected.
